svg.title: Mollier chart: locating the HP inlet state 1
svg.text: Mollier chart: locating the HP inlet state 1
Mollier chart for steam (as attached to the paper: s 5–9, h 2000–4000), redrawn from IAPWS-97
2s: on the 14 bar isobar at h₂ₛ = h₁ − w_HP/η_HP = 3075 − 337 = 2738 kJ/kg (just wet, x ≈ 0.974).
State 1 has the same entropy (s = 6.36): go straight up from 2s to h₁ = 3075 kJ/kg.
Point 1 lies between the 60 and 70 bar isobars (dark lines) and close to the 350–400 °C isotherms.
Interpolate: P₁ ≈ 64 bar (violet isobar) and T₁ ≈ 365 °C (red isotherm).
Redrawn from the IAPWS-97 steam properties; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
